name: Jay Bhattacharya
current_role: Director of the National Institutes of Health (since April 2025)
summary: Jay Bhattacharya, a Stanford health economist who co-wrote the Great Barrington Declaration against pandemic lockdowns, has directed the NIH since April 2025. From February 2026 he also ran the CDC as acting director until Erica Schwartz was confirmed in August.
